title: Two-photon Fluorescence Microscopy of Dermatologic Biopsies
official: Expanded Two-photon Imaging of Skin Biopsy Specimens
summary:
The goal of this study is to investigate the ability of two-photon fluorescence microscopy to evaluate dermatologic biopsies. The main questions it aims to answer are:

• How well do two-photon fluorescence images of biopsies taken in a clinic and evaluated by a pathologist agree with conventional histology?
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Punch, excisional or shave biopsy specimen

Exclusion Criteria:

* Biopsies composed of multiple excisions or pieces
